issues.detail: Galley/door vinyl still a uniform slab
issues.problem: L std 6.4 vs 24.1 and low-frequency std 4.9 vs 12.5 (ra_door2floor 380-560 x 330-550 against sans_09 250-450 x 450-620). The w8 fbm change in the layer-7 generator is attenuated by LAYER_PARAMS[7] = [2.0, 0.15, 0.45, 0.2] (albedo strength 0.45) and by the 0.5 m tile, which makes the clouds ~0.17 m. The photo's clouds are 0.3-0.5 m.
issues.fix: 03_tex.js l.62 (shared, one line): LAYER_PARAMS 7: [2.0, 0.15, 0.45, 0.2] -> [1.0, 0.15, 1.3, 0.2]. That gives a 1 m tile (clouds ~0.33 m) and ~3x the albedo modulation. Check that the speckles do not become blotchy, and keep the mean near (100,97,102).

issues.detail: Shade button LED ring pale lavender, not saturated blue-violet
issues.problem: The brightest ring pixels in ra_fWin are (178,172,250), s 0.31. tt_window has (67,81,240) and omaat_room24 (32,0,255), both s >= 0.7. In the photos the ring is the most saturated thing on the wall. Ours reads as a faint outline in s01, s05 and ra_fWin.
issues.fix: src/07_shell.js l.132: halo { c: '#5a55ff', e: 0.55 } -> { c: '#2a30ff', e: 0.45 }, so less emission clips less to white after tonemapping. Optionally widen the ring by ~30 % so it survives at 930 px.

issues.detail: Door surround has no stop fittings or cream frame
issues.problem: Unchanged. fr_20220604_123806 shows six cast stop fittings per jamb and a cream frame.
issues.fix: Add 6 small blocks (0.05 x 0.035 x 0.025 m, a cream/grey latch tone) per jamb on the surround face, spaced 0.25 m from 0.3 to 1.6 m.

issues.detail: PY/Y hood reads as a grey cloud at aisle distance
issues.problem: The numbers now match sp_py14, but the photo also shows a light specular sheen on the lower tub floor and the lower side walls. That sheen makes the darkening read as a concave hood. Ours is matte, so the grey patch floats (s02, win_close tub 2).
issues.fix: Optional: give the reveal a slightly lower roughness (MAT.reveal r about 0.45) so the sill and lower side walls pick up a sheen, or lift the sill rings (dv < -oTop) to 1.05.

issues.detail: Sidewall panels lack the fine woven texture
issues.problem: tt_window shows a fine linen texture on the panels. Ours is plain satin. It is subtle at 930 px but visible in the close-ups (ra_fWin, ra_dadoY).
issues.fix: Give the sidewall material LAYER.fabric (or the plastic layer) at a low normal strength.
